Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini logged two assists, including one on the power play, and added two PIM and a minus-3 rating in Monday's 5-2 loss to the Wild.
Celebrini scored a goal and added an assist, both on the power play, in Saturday's 4-3 win over the Kraken.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard notched two assists and three shots on goal in Tuesday's 5-3 loss to the Golden Knights.
Bouchard distributed two assists and served two PIM in Sunday's 5-2 win over Philadelphia.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider logged two assists, four hits and a plus-2 rating in Wednesday's 5-1 win over the Canucks.
Seider had two assists, two shots on goal and two blocked shots in Thursday's 5-4 loss to the Panthers.

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes notched two assists, including one on the power play, and added two shots on goal in Saturday's 9-6 loss to the Blues.
Hughes scored an empty-net goal on three shots in Thursday's 5-2 win over the Capitals.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier scored a power-play goal on two shots in Wednesday's 7-0 win over the Sharks.
Gauthier scored a goal on four shots and delivered two hits in Monday's 3-2 loss to the Kraken.

Dylan Guenther.summary: Guenther scored a goal on three shots and added a power-play assist in Wednesday's 4-3 win over the Wild.
Guenther failed to produce a point while putting three shots on net and recording a minus-3 rating in Monday's 4-2 loss to the Jets.

Jakob Chychrun.summary: Chychrun scored a power-play goal on three shots, dished an assist, added four PIM and blocked two shots in Saturday's 7-5 loss to the Bruins.
Chychrun tallied a power-play goal, picked up an assist and launched five shots on net in Tuesday's 6-5 loss to Dallas.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored the game-winning goal and added two assists, one on the power play, in Wednesday's 7-3 win over the Flyers.
Tuch scored a shorthanded goal on five shots and blocked two shots in Saturday's 7-5 loss to the Bruins.

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman turned away 14 of 17 shots on net in Wednesday's 4-2 loss to the Jets.
Swayman will start Wednesday's home game against the Jets, Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now reports.
Jeremy Swayman.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Jack Studley (Boston Hockey Now)

Brandt Clarke.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Zach Dooley (Kings')

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke (upper body) won't return to Thursday's game versus the Senators.

Connor Bedard.summary: Bedard underwent successful shoulder surgery Monday and is expected to make a full recovery in approximately four months.
Bedard (shoulder) was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

Connor Hellebuyck.summary: Hellebuyck made 22 saves in a 3-2 shootout win over Columbus on Wednesday.
Hellebuyck is expected to start on the road against Columbus on Wednesday, per Amanda Stein of the Devils' official site.
Connor Hellebuyck.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Amanda Stein (Devils')

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev (lower body) will join the Rangers for their two-game road trip, Mollie Walker of the New York Post reports Tuesday.
Pavel Dorofeyev.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Mollie Walker (New York Post)

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev (lower body) was placed on injured reserve on Saturday, per Peter Baugh of The Athletic.
Pavel Dorofeyev.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Peter Baugh (The Athletic.)

Mark Stone.summary: Stone scored a power-play goal on three shots, added two hits and went minus-2 in Sunday's 6-3 loss to the Canucks.
Stone scored a power-play goal in Monday's 3-2 shootout loss to the Bruins.

Justin Faulk.summary: Faulk scored a power-play goal and added an even-strength assist in Monday's 5-3 win over the Panthers.
Faulk scored a power-play goal on four shots, added two blocked shots and logged two PIM in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson Ek scored two even-strength goals, including an empty-netter, on four shots and added a power-play assist in Monday's 5-2 win over the Sharks.
Eriksson Ek scored a goal on two shots and added an assist in Thursday's 4-1 win over the Flames.

Mikael Granlund.summary: Granlund notched three assists, four shots on goal, two PIM and a plus-2 rating in Wednesday's 7-0 win over the Sharks.
Granlund scored a power-play goal on three shots, dished an assist and blocked two shots in Tuesday's 8-6 loss to the Blues.

Mackenzie Blackwood.summary: Blackwood posted a 28-save shutout in Wednesday's 6-0 win over the Canadiens.
Blackwood will guard the crease at home versus the Canadiens on Wednesday, Jesse Montano of Guerilla Sports reports.
Mackenzie Blackwood.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Jesse Montano (Guerilla Sports)

Charle-Edouard D'Astous.summary: D'Astous scored a goal Tuesday in a 5-2 win over Washington.
D'Astous scored a goal and added two assists in a 4-3 overtime win over the Wild on Saturday.

Jack Quinn.summary: Quinn scored a goal on four shots and added two hits in Wednesday's 5-1 win over the Rangers.
Quinn scored a goal on three shots and went plus-2 in Sunday's 6-2 win over the Lightning.

Victor Olofsson.summary: Olofsson scored a power-play goal on two shots in Thursday's 4-3 shootout loss to the Stars.
Olofsson scored a power-play goal and went minus-3 in Sunday's 6-3 loss to the Canucks.

Robert Thomas.summary: Thomas scored a goal on two shots and added two assists, including one on the power play, in Saturday's 9-6 win over the Devils.
Thomas notched three assists in Thursday's 5-2 win over Pittsburgh.

Frank Nazar.summary: Nazar scored a goal on two shots and added a power-play assist in Sunday's 6-3 win over the Canucks.
Nazar scored a power-play goal on four shots and added two hits in Thursday's 4-2 loss to the Blue Jackets.
